steps.message:

Facebook had a purge last night, 

Use tools to write only the requested answer to /app/answer.txt. Do not search the web. The final chat reply may briefly confirm completion.

"half my friend list is just bots from 2017 and honestly? good riddance" = half(1) my(2) friend(3) list(4) is(5) just(6) bots(7) from(8) 2017(9) and(10) honestly(11) good(12) riddance(13). 13 words. Good, casual tone, casual "purge" stance.

Or "my friend count dropped by 400 and they're all just bots so bye" = 15 words.

Casing: the prefix ends with "purge last night, " so lowercase continuation is natural. "half my friend list is just bots from 2017 and honestly? good riddance" — 63 characters + 35 = no problem.

Should I uppercase? "Good riddance" — maybe it's better to keep everything lowercase for the casual vibe. "honestly? good riddance" is fine.

Write to /app/answer.txt.
